lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately four horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a structured grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of bright blobs to form distinct anchor nodes at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a distinct luminance gradient with light-reflecting surfaces on the dorsal edge and shadow-casting on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small, circular high-luminance spots; multiple Echeneidae individuals are visible attached to the ventral region of the pectoral fin and the lower abdomen.
